notes.title: Our Home Update – New Features, Improvements, and Pioneers Vault DLC
notes.content:
Hello, community! 

First and foremost, we want to clarify that this is not the planned update for June but rather an interim version with fixes, improvements, and new content. While this update brings playable additions, they do not advance the main storyline, focusing instead on extra content to enrich your experience. 


Why this update?
Originally, we planned to release the next major update on 06/27. However, due to the need for additional adjustments, that version is not yet ready. To ensure compatibility with our upcoming release, the DLC Pioneers Vault, we are providing this interim update. We apologize for the delay and thank you for your understanding.


Introducing the Pioneers Vault DLC
Now available to add to your Steam wishlist, the Pioneers Vault DLC offers exclusive content for fans of Our Home. This DLC includes:


Secret photo gallery fully unlocked.
    

Replay gallery unlocked to revisit memorable moments.
    

Step-by-step guide with tips for making the best decisions in the game.



The Pioneers Vault will be regularly updated with new extra content to enhance gameplay. All features are optional and can be activated individually through a dedicated menu.

Note: This DLC will be available for purchase only during early access. After the official release of Our Home, it will no longer be available, at least not with all the planned content.

Add Pioneers Vault to your wishlist

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/a866d28f5acab91cf67b22b75f80ca1db65d4890.png"]
What's New in This Update
This version introduces new and experimental content we’re testing to improve Our Home:


New Lorena character quiz: Test your knowledge about the character!
    

6 new secret images: Discover them by exploring the game.
    

Free-roam event with Lorena: A new casual content to interact with the character.



The free-roam event can be accessed by disabling Visual Novel (VN) mode and checking Lorena’s personal calendar.


Sprite Experiments: Speeding Up Development
We’re testing a new sprite technique to streamline the creation of casual content, such as conversations that enrich the storyline. In this update, we applied this approach to Lorena’s free-roam event, following a successful test with the character Hicco.

This technique will not replace the complex scenes in Our Home, which will maintain their high level of detail. However, sprites allow us to add lighter interactions more quickly, keeping the game dynamic, and will only be used for casual free-roam scenes. When a free-roam scene requires more complex interactions, such as a sex scene or something more intimate, the standard storytelling format will be used. 



We’d love your feedback on this new feature! If it’s well-received, we’ll continue implementing it in future updates.  


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/94e7b2a1412bdec1b4288e7a51c95c587c219e5a.gif"]
Improvements in Free-Roam and VN Mode Integration


We’ve worked to make the Visual Novel (VN) and free-roam modes more seamless. Now, after completing the main storyline content, you can explore the map and find secret images without switching modes. This change makes transitions between modes smoother and ensures you have playable content even after finishing the story, keeping the fun going until the next update. When the new version is released, your progress will automatically load, and you’ll continue the story from where you left off, just like in any other game. While this integration may feel a bit challenging at first, our goal is to make it increasingly intuitive over time.  


What’s Next?
The next update is in development and will be released as soon as it’s ready, which should take about 10 days. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience and continued support. Our Home is a work in progress, and your feedback is essential in shaping the game’s future.


[hr]


Thank you for being part of the Our Home journey!


[/hr]

notes.title: New Update Now Available: More Content and Improvements in the Game!
notes.content:
Hello, Our Home community!

We have great news: we've decided to release the new update ahead of schedule! This doesn't replace the update planned for next month, which remains confirmed. This means more content for you in less time! Here are the highlights of this version:

What's New?


~840 renders, ~20,000 words (about 1h10 of reading), 3 animations, 9 secret renders, and 1 new achievement.

Revamped Environments: Norah’s house, the rental room, and Aquila now feature higher-quality renders, 
enhanced realism, and expanded scenes, setting the stage for free-roam mode.

New Navigation Model: An experimental integration between Visual Novel (VN) and free-roam modes. After completing the story in VN mode, explore new areas and find extra content without switching modes. In the future, we aim to fully integrate VN and free-roam modes, eliminating the need to switch at the end of the game's story.

Meet Hicco, the Curious Parrot!: An experimental feature for free-roam mode. Interact with Hicco, a talkative parrot flying around PinePool, offering challenges with riddles based on town conversations. Solve them to unlock items! This mechanic uses simpler animations for casual interactions, allowing more free-roam content without compromising the quality of unique story interactions. This approach aims to speed up the development of free-roam events, our next focus after releasing the prologue rework, which you've already enjoyed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/1bd20e229bbbc4bc97fdc15468f5279df2565afa.gif

 We've fixed several minor bugs found during development.


What's Next?
Version 3.03, already in production, will be larger, focusing on the protagonist and more elaborate scenes (including some spicier ones!).

We Hope You Enjoy It!
What do you think of Hicco and the new navigation model? Leave your comments, suggestions, or criticism here or on our contact channels. See you soon!

Thank you for being part of this journey!

notes.title: Our Home Update: Progress and Plans
notes.content:
Hello everyone, welcome to the Our Home update status!

In this post, we want to share what you can expect from the next Steam update and give you a glimpse into our process. As outlined in the Early Access details, our updates roll out quarterly. This approach lets us plan the scope of each release and the playtime you’ll enjoy.

Based on our development capacity, we produce around 400 renders per month, translating to about 30 minutes of gameplay or reading. Over a quarter, that’s roughly 1200 renders and 1h30 of new content. Our Home has a special trait: we believe every character’s expression and line matters for deeper immersion. That’s why we craft about 1 renders per dialogue. Not everyone might notice this while playing, but it’s something we take pride in delivering for you.


What’s Ready So Far

As of now, here’s what we’ve accomplished: since February 26, we’ve created around 490 renders, 3 animations, and about 35 minutes of gameplay. This version spans two distinct moments: the start of a temp job at Aquila with Norah’s schedule, featuring some intense scenes, and a college interview with Alexandra, plus a short segment of Samantha’s investigation. These are the highlights of this update, and below, you’ll find preview images of what’s coming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/6b579a82430584ae6d29c9230d72feca6c311941.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/70b10d44ce073ebedeb67b1af66ccc5609386ba7.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/21c2230e06973885324626d6b068fd5420b8af8e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/87c2dbee9e5617b7c0aa71a2954381ff3116a6bc.jpg


We know many of you are eager for the next update and might wonder, “Why not release it already?” We get that excitement! Our focus is on keeping Our Home sustainable long-term, delivering meaningful, polished content each quarter. This strategy ensures more playtime and a richer experience with every release something we think you’ll love.

We’re thrilled about what’s ahead and keeping a close eye on everything you share with us. The next status report will bring even more news, and we’re counting on you to join us on this ride!

notes.title: New Update: Tweaks and Fixes
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! We’re here with a new update bringing improvements. This isn’t an update with new content, but rather tweaks and fixes to make your experience even more enjoyable. Let’s dive into the details:

New Features and Improvements


Virtual Keyboard for Controllers
Now, players using controllers have a virtual keyboard to make things easier. Whether on PC or Steam Deck, interacting is simpler without switching devices.

Interface Font Adjustments
We’ve increased font sizes across the interface for comfortable reading, especially on Steam Deck, but also on other platforms. Everything’s more legible and prettier!

Landscape Photos on Mobile
Added support for landscape photos on mobile, with automatic -90º rotation after capture. Your images now stay at the right angle effortlessly.

Game Image Overhaul
We’ve adjusted 100% of the images to reduce texture sharpness, better aligning them with the characters’ ages. We found a post-processing issue that made skins sharper than intended;

What does this mean? Almost the entire game will need to be re-downloaded due to this massive fix. We apologize for the inconvenience, but the result is worth it: textures now match the vision we planned.
Going forward? We’ve tweaked post-processing to prevent this from happening again.



Below is an example of this correction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/5ef20ee0f2b288e872bdbb1d01a391a5497e2bc6.jpg


Bug Fixes and Tweaks


Fixed minor UI bugs to polish everything up.
Adjusted message sorting! Contacts with the latest messages now appear first in most cases, keeping the timeline clear and improving the experience when a message arrives mid-event.


Narrative Consistency and the Prologue

After reworking the prologue, we knew we’d need to tweak the narrative between the first psychologist visit and Samantha’s initial investigation mission. Our original plan was to do this gradually, focusing on new content and render quality for that section.


Why now? With the image fixes due to unwanted sharpness, we decided to tackle this narrative revision early. It delayed the update a bit, but it felt like the right time.
What changed? Nothing in the story itself – we just refined the text to better reflect character personalities and align with the new prologue.
What’s next? Moving forward, we’ll only enhance images in this section, leaving the text as is. We believe the adjustments meet our goals.
Do I need to replay? Not required, but if you’d like to revisit the dialogues and share feedback, we’re always open to hearing from you!


This update reflects our commitment to improving the game and listening to the community. Thank you for sticking with us on this journey – your comments and support make all the difference. See you in-game!

notes.title: Understanding Features and Settings in Our Home
notes.content:
Hello, Our Home players! 🏡

We understand that some settings or features might not be immediately clear, so we’ve put together this official to help you navigate the core aspects of the game. While most of these details are already available in-game as tooltips when you hover over each function, this guide consolidates everything into one handy reference. Below, you’ll find detailed explanations of each feature, where to find them, and how they work. Our goal is to ensure your experience is as smooth as possible, whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned player. Let’s dive in!

[hr][/hr]

1. Main Menu

The Main Menu is the first screen you see when you launch the game. It contains the core options to start or customize your experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/13e29631a064e373575fa45fdff32613c79573d2.png

The Main Menu screen of Our Home


    Start: Opens a submenu with two initial options:
    
        Start from Scratch: Begins a new adventure. You can choose between two gameplay modes:
        
            Free-Roam: A fully open Free-Roam mode where you can explore events, actions, and secrets—including exclusive easter eggs—without any grinding. You have the freedom to navigate and engage with the world at your own pace. While the mode is fully functional and provides a solid experience, we’re still working on enhancements, such as adding new events to make it even more engaging. You can switch to VN Mode at any time without losing progress (see details in the “Game” section).
            VN Mode: A narrative-focused mode ideal for players who prefer a more streamlined reading experience while still retaining free-roam navigation within events. You can enable or disable this mode at any time, giving you full flexibility.
        
        Load from Cloud: Retrieves your progress saved in the cloud, including nearly all game data: progress, relationships, unlocked locations, replays, secret images, phone contacts, character info, settings, and more. Please note that this is not an official Steam feature but a completely optional function we’ve implemented. Use it carefully to avoid any risk of disrupting your local save files.
    

    Load: Allows you to load a locally saved game to continue where you left off.
    Preferences: Opens the settings menu (detailed below).
    Gallery: Displays the secret images you’ve unlocked throughout the game.
    Replay: Lists available replays, letting you relive notable scenes.
    Help: Provides a submenu with explanations of controls and basic Ren’Py functions.
    Quit: Closes the game.


[hr][/hr]

2. Preferences Menu (Settings)

Where to Find: Accessible from the Main Menu or by pausing the game (usually with the ESC key or a designated button). This menu lets you customize various aspects of the game to suit your preferences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/4e777ef8d04c0f4f0befbe48e720e9de44bbb837.png

The Preferences Menu lets you fine-tune your experience

Game
General settings that affect gameplay and visual experience:


    VN Mode: Enables/disables Visual Novel Mode, focusing on main events for a more linear narrative. Even in this mode, free-roam navigation within events is preserved. You can toggle between VN Mode and Free-Roam at any time without losing progress.
    Legacy Skip Time: Activates the older time-skipping system, allowing you to skip forward by 1, 2, or 3 hours instead of jumping directly to a specific time on the calendar. (Free-roam mode)
    Mini-games: When enabled, automatically skips all mini-games and marks them as completed.  (Free-roam mode)
    Save Name: Allows you to manually name your save files.
    Transitions: Toggles visual transitions (images and videos) that indicate changes in time or location.
    Hover Navigation: Lets you move between environments in Free-Roam Mode by simply hovering your mouse over location-change buttons—no clicking needed. This speeds up exploration, but clicking still works if you prefer.
    Side Image: Shows a character’s image next to the dialogue box when enabled.
    Particles: Toggles the particle system (e.g. floating dust) for added immersion. Disable for a cleaner screen or better performance on lower-end devices.
    Mouse Point: Sets the mouse cursor to your operating system’s default style. Requires a game restart to apply changes.
    Hide Windows: Adds a button to hide all windows in the dialogue box.
    Proofreader: When enabled (requires internet), adds a button in dialogues and choices to report text or translation errors directly to the development team.
    Proofreader Interface: Similar to Proofreader but adds the reporting button to interface elements (e.g. Main Menu labels).


Dialogue
Options to customize how dialogue is displayed:


    Change Color of Dialogue and Choices: Adjusts the text color of dialogues and choices.
    Change Color of Thoughts: Adjusts the text color of character thoughts.
    Text Speed: Controls how quickly text appears.
    Dialogue Box Transparency: Sets the level of transparency for the dialogue box.
    Dialogue Text Size: Adjusts the font size of dialogue text.
    Character Name Size: Adjusts the font size of character names.
    Choice Text Size: Adjusts the font size of choice options.


Skip
Settings for skipping game content:


    Skip Unseen: Allows skipping of unseen dialogue or scenes (use carefully to avoid missing key content).
    Skip After Choice: Continues skipping automatically after you make a choice.


Rollback
Controls the rollback feature to revisit past content:


    Disabled: Disables rollback for a strictly linear experience.
    Left: Allows rewinding the game (scroll wheel or specific inputs) to review past dialogue.
    Forward: After rolling back, lets you move forward again to return to your previous point.


Sound
Audio adjustments for your experience:


    Music: Controls the background music volume.
    Sound Effects: Adjusts the volume of SFX, including one-time sounds, moans, and loops.
    Mute Control: Adds quick mute/unmute buttons for audio channels in the dialogue box.


Video
Video settings (available only on PC):


    Display Window: Runs the game in windowed mode (useful for multitasking).
    Display Full Screen: Runs the game in full-screen mode for greater immersion.


Language
Choose the game’s language from the available options.

Relations
Lets you adjust how characters refer to each other (in third-person or groups), customizing dialogues and interactions.

[hr][/hr]

3. Other Key Features


    Gallery: Displays unlocked secret images (accessible from the Main Menu).
    Replay: Lets you revisit specific scenes (accessible from the Main Menu).
    Help: Provides explanations of controls and basic functions (accessible from the Main Menu).
    Load: Loads locally saved games (available in the Main Menu or by pausing the game).


[hr][/hr]

Questions or Issues?

If you still have questions or need assistance with any feature, feel free to leave a comment or reach out through our official channels (such as our Discord). We’re here to ensure your experience with Our Home is the best it can be!

notes.title: Our Home – Launching Today on Steam in Early Access!
notes.content:
Welcome, everyone!

We're just hours away from launching Our Home on Steam in Early Access, and we can’t wait to share this journey with you! First and foremost, a huge thank you to everyone who has supported us along the way—your energy has brought us to this moment.

Now, let’s get to the good part: what you can expect from this release!

[hr][/hr]


A Growing Experience: From Wishlist to Early Access

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/b078cd3afa4f49df832c46858cfafc01c2ee0bbd.png

Since we announced our Wishlist, we have been working hard to expand and refine the experience, adding more depth to the story, visuals, and gameplay.

Where We Started

At the time of the Wishlist announcement, Our Home already had:
🖼️ 5,700 high-quality images
🎬 52 animations, enriching the visual experience
💬 5,403 dialogue blocks, forming a deep narrative with 61,931 words
📖 An estimated 5-hour read time, offering a significant immersion in the initial story

But we didn’t stop there!

What We Added

With continuous development, we expanded the game time by more than 90 minutes, introducing new content focused on the main story. These improvements dive deeper into the mysteries of Norah’s past and present, while Samantha’s investigations uncover hidden connections—with our hero at the center of it all.

🔥 1,700+ brand-new renders, crafted to bring emotional and detailed scenes to life
🔍 Secret renders for those who love to explore every hidden detail

This massive expansion set the stage for our biggest update yet—the complete rework of the prologue!


[hr][/hr]

A Prologue Designed for Immersion

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/4a5258a30fab8a4b6e353d79975bdc77a4e292e9.png


This launch includes a special prologue rework, built from the ground up over the past 12 months. We've rewritten scenes, refined the narrative, and enhanced the visuals to create a rich and engaging experience right from the start.

Here’s what we’ve achieved:
✅ Renders: Increased from ~600 to over 1,400
✅ Dialogues: Expanded from ~100 to over 1,300
✅ Word Count: From ~1,000 to over 24,000
✅ Average Playtime: From 20 minutes to over 1.5 hours

Our goal is simple: to deliver a compelling story with characters you'll want to connect with. The prologue rework introduces the MC and their world—from their bonds with Amelia and Jonathan to MC ’s deep love for Emily—all with more detail and emotion.

[hr][/hr]

Behind the Creation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/f665ff521c5cac89555ccaa2287490b0a5d2e47e.png

When I first envisioned Our Home, I wanted a strong narrative, with a clear path and a memorable ending. Become a writer and choosing 3D and storytelling was a massive challenge—I lacked both the resources and experience at the beginning.

But over time, with incredible support from my wife, we turned this vision into reality. This prologue rework is the result of months of learning and dedication, and we’re proud to present it as the starting point of our journey on Steam.


[hr][/hr]
What to Expect in the Prologue?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/067a770e6b21f8ecd6b14349a2b87ce2073b61d4.png

👤 Amelia – Deeper connections with the other characters and the impact of the MC’s departure from the orphanage.
🤝 Jonathan & MC – A friendship brought to life, setting the stage for what's to come.
❤️ MC & Emily – A love explored through special scenes, showing why she means so much.
🌎 Others – Samantha, Hank, Juliana, Matilda, and more—all introduced naturally, with distinct personalities.

As soon as you start Our Home, you’ll dive straight into the prologue—the perfect introduction for new players like you.

[hr][/hr]

Looking Ahead to 2025

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/dc0b498ed6d6cb81143d8d6521f444dfe4c64eb5.png

As an Early Access title, this is just the beginning. Our plan for 2025 is to:
🔹 Expand the free exploration content
🔹 Progress the main story
🔹 Complete Chapter 1 within 18 months
🔹 Deliver regular updates, side stories, and much more

We’re excited to build this world together with you!

[hr][/hr]

A Modern, Intuitive UI

Over the past few months, we’ve redesigned the entire interface to make it smoother and more immersive:
🔹 Interactive menus
🔹 A gallery for scenes and hidden images
🤝 "Higram"—our in-game Instagram, featuring a personal profile and community reactions

Everything has been designed to enhance your experience!

[hr][/hr]

Launching Today

The past months have been intense, but every effort has been worth it to bring this experience to you.
Our Home is about building something special, and as Early Access players, you are a key part of that.
🚀 See you in the game—get ready for what’s coming next!

notes.title: Our Home: A Richer and More Engaging Universe
notes.content:
"Hello, everyone! We’re thrilled to share how the universe of Our Home has grown over the past months. We’ve worked hard to ensure your experience is richer, more engaging, and unforgettable. Here are the highlights:"


More Story to Explore
Since we announced our Wishlist, we’ve added over 90 minutes of additional gameplay, focusing on new content for the main story. These expansions delve into the mysteries of Norah’s past and present, while Samantha’s investigations uncover deep connections — with our hero at the center of it all.

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/b5e7e2bead3d293f389617f8a9dc748631ce490e.jpg

[hr][/hr]

As development continues, we’ve added over 1,700 new renders, designed to create exciting, detailed, and meaningful scenes. Additionally, we’ve included secret renders for those who love exploring every corner of the game.

New Characters and Dynamics
As the story progresses, you’ll encounter new faces that bring emotional depth and unexpected intrigue:


Alexandra Blanchett
The university dean is a standout figure. Her cunning actions make her an essential ally in Norah’s plans, but she has her own agenda: to manipulate Samantha’s investigation (and more) while steering the protagonist’s path. We’re excited to see how her role unfolds!

Karol
Young, introspective, and burdened by a painful past, Karol brings a new layer of emotion to the orphanage and beyond. Initially subtle, her presence becomes increasingly crucial as the story develops.


These characters, alongside the main cast, create an environment where every decision matters and every relationship hides secrets waiting to be uncovered.

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/906f3f71cad3591cf886227e8090128c21ec2d43.jpg

[hr][/hr]

Optimization and Polish
In addition to expanding content, we’ve made significant strides in game optimization. We reduced the total file size without compromising render quality. Minor bugs have been fixed, ensuring the Early Access experience is smoother and more polished.

Prologue Revision
Our commitment to quality extends to the prologue rework. We’re revisiting and expanding the opening to offer a clearer, more engaging experience for both new and veteran players.

This rework is progressing slowly, as we always prioritize creating new content. When it’s ready, we’ll ensure you can explore the changes without affecting your current progress in the game. We aim to have a significant portion of this rework ready for the first Early Access release.

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/93172eff91d8711519acdc7f9f8853922c050ffe.jpg

[hr][/hr]

Ready for Early Access?
If you haven’t added Our Home to your Wishlist yet, do it now to receive notifications about the release and never miss an update. With over 90 minutes of additional story and 1,700+ new renders, we’re sure you’ll dive headfirst into the world of Our Home!

Thank you for being with us, and see you in the next update!

(Share your impressions in the comments — we love hearing what you think!)

notes.title: Next steps Q3/2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/f2865026efe83157c3b8e1516a10459ba415b7ce.jpg

Hello everyone.

This is our first post here, so I want to start by explaining to those who are not yet familiar with how our updates work.

We divide our work development into quarters, and each quarter we release content for a character.
Our average number of renderings per quarter is 1,050, and we usually create one render per dialogue, because we believe that each expression in a visual novel is important.
The average reading time per quarter is 1h20m.

Our initial plan is that each character, except for the key characters in the story, will have at least 2 versions, meaning they will be in focus for 2 quarters, but not necessarily consecutive quarters, by the end of the first chapter of "Our Home." At this moment, we have the following status.


 Juliana: 1 Versions.
 Emily: 2 Versions (Key character, which means she will have more versions than the other characters.)
 Marta: 1 Versions.
 Danielle: 1 Version.
 MC: ~3 versions (Key character, which means she will have more versions than the other characters.)


We plan for other characters to be in focus by the end of the first chapter.

Now I want to share with you our plans for Q3/2024.

In the next steps for the upcoming three versions of "Our Home". In the next version, our protagonist (MC) will be closer to discovering the truth about his story. However, we first need to connect some important points, involving key characters and significant events. Samantha and Hank will have key roles in this version.
